images.label: alley_confrontation
images.prompt: A dim, rain-slicked alley at night, neon signs flicker with corrupted glyphs in Chinese-inspired script; a terrified man in worn civilian clothes backs against graffiti-covered brick wall, lit by cold blue bioluminescent streetlights and pulsing red emergency glow from a distant drone; cyberpunk style, medium close-up, shallow depth of field, cinematic chiaroscuro lighting with high contrast and volumetric fog.

images.label: occult_apartment
images.prompt: Cluttered apartment interior bathed in sickly green monitor light and faint UV glow; walls covered in hand-drawn occult symbols, arcane diagrams, and fragmented AI circuit schematics overlapping like neural lace; a lone investigator in tactical trench coat examines scattered ritual notes under focused desk lamp beam; sci-fi noir style, wide-angle composition with diagonal tension, low-key lighting, deep shadows, subtle lens flare from screen reflections.

images.label: hooded_figure
images.prompt: A shadowy figure in a flowing black hooded cloak stands at the edge of a derelict subway tunnel, facing away; glowing violet irises visible through an ornate bronze mask, faint energy trails curling from fingertips toward floating holographic glyphs; background dissolves into data static and fragmented surveillance footage; anime-style sci-fi, centered vertical composition, dramatic backlighting from unseen source, high-detail linework, atmospheric haze, cool purple-black color grade.
